name: isl_saar6c
title: File:Korvette der Sa'ar-6-Klasse.jpg
author: Marco Kuntzsch
description: A corvette of the Sa'ar-6 class for Israel in front of the construction yard in Kiel on 23.09.2020. The unit bears a nameplate with the German name "Habicht" (meaning goshawk). Maybe that's the German translation of the intended Israeli name for that ship.
